actions.add-skills: Add the ones I have to my profile
actions.create-profile: Create my profile from my CV

noRequests: No requests. On any agent button, the dropdown offers “Leave for my next session”.
title: Agent
intro: Your agents and what you have left for their next session. They use your subscription: you do not pay extra per run.

costs.title: Cost
costs.intro: What background runs have used, as each agent reports it. Tokens are the unit agents use to measure the text they read and write: more tokens, more use of your subscription.
costs.terminal: Only background runs count: what you do in a terminal does not reach the app. “Instructions size” is how heavy each action's instructions are, so you know where to trim.
costs.thresholdIntro: In the background, “Assess new jobs” only assesses jobs with this fit or higher, so it does not spend on those that almost surely do not fit; “To review” says why each one was left unassessed. The minimum to reach “To review” is {{triage}}; by default, this one is {{default}}.

thresholdSource.policies: It comes from the app's default settings.

jobCost.title: Agent cost
jobCost.terminal: What you do in a terminal does not count: there the agent does not report its usage.

window.title: Open in a window
window.off: Off: what the agent can do without a window (generating the CV, assessing a job…) is followed in the notice at the bottom right, with its conversation. Everything else opens in its window.
window.on: On: the main button always opens the agent in its window. The button menu can still start it without a window, just that once.

summary.readyHint: The buttons with the robot all over the app open it in a separate window with the command already written: there you see what it does and approve it.
summary.cantOpen: Your agent cannot be opened from here
summary.cantOpenHint: {{reason}} The buttons with the robot show you the command so you can copy it and paste it into your agent.
